name: python-topological-sort
title: Topological Order Walker
blurb: predecessors-first ordering of small integer-keyed digraphs: the order's listing validates against every shipped edge on every shipped and seeded corpus, every node sits exactly once, the sequence is a fixed point, and a cycle names its block honestly.
default_description: A topological orderer whose listing is the naive picker's sequence on every small digraph, and whose tangles name their block honestly.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: a node is released only when its last predecessor has gone
